messages:
anya: Quick one  installing redwood-sdk via poetry in a small sample app causes the solver to spin. pip install works fine. Anyone have a short checklist?
tom: Which poetry version + python?
anya: poetry 1.4.2 in local dev image, CI uses 1.5.1. Python 3.9. redwood-sdk 0.12.0 pinned.
biz: Common things: typing-extensions, httpx extras, or very loose requires can blow up the resolver. Do you have a pyproject snippet?
anya: Minimal deps: `fastapi`, `redwood-sdk=0.12.0`, `typing-extensions^4.5`.
tom: Try pinning typing-extensions to an exact minor (e.g. ^4.6). That reduced time for us. Also upgrading poetry to 1.5.x helps.
anya: Confirmed pin to ^4.6 + poetry 1.5.3 made lock complete in CI. Will document.
biz: Filing INFRA-8499 for SDK team to audit optional extras and looseness. If anyone hits this externally, recommend pip install wheel as fallback or pin transitive deps.
pip-bot: Ticket INFRA-8499 created by biz; labels: packaging, poetry
